summary: @servicetitan/log-service preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases and then execFileSyncs it against a sibling math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a ~728 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated Bun-only script (hex-named identifiers, large opaque numeric string-array, character-shuffling decoder) that is not referenced by the declared main (dist/index.js) or any file under src. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js sit at the tarball root outside the author's own "files": ["dist", "src"] manifest, so they are shipped only to be executed by the preinstall hook and do not participate in the advertised log-service API. Using a freshly-downloaded alternate JS runtime to execute an obfuscated payload on npm install is the alternate-runtime-dropper attack shape and executes attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine with the runtime's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
